programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: Le Quatrième Pouvoir
programme.desc: Un journaliste se retrouve impliqué dans un complot terroriste à Moscou alors qu'il enquête sur les services secrets russes.

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l’envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l’Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l’amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l’Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Le Vétérans
programme.desc: Trente ans après la chute de Saigon, le politicien Ray Watson retourne au Vietnam pour apaiser ses démons, mais il est confronté à un prisonnier de guerre qu'il a laissé derrière lui et qui le force à revivre le jour de leur capture.

programme.title: Habib, la grande aventure
programme.desc: La vie d’Habib, un jeune acteur bruxellois issu de l’immigration marocaine, qui a l’opportunité de jouer le rôle principal dans un film sur la vie de François d’Assise.

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l’université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d’un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Border Run
programme.desc: Une journaliste américaine recherche son frère disparu sur fond de violence et de trafic d'êtres humains à la frontière américano-mexicaine.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. - April est venue pour se suicider ; Krysta et Dennis s’échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens ; Peg, l’épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse ; et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. - April demande de l’aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s’il peut l’accompagner. - Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. - Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu’ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. - Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Un Endroit Sombre
programme.desc: Lorsqu’un jeune garçon disparaît dans une petite ville tranquille, Donald, un chauffeur de camion de voirie local, se lance dans une enquête précaire et obsessionnelle, jouant les détectives.

programme.title: Ma Fille Kidnappée!
programme.desc: Après que Teri, une voisine, ait proposé de "garder" sa fille et que celle-ci ait disparu, Susan, une mère, devra revenir sur la mort de son mari pour la sauver.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

Au milieu de cette guerre, Jaime, le neveu de Veronica, qui souffre d'un cancer et doit être sauvé, comme Rodrigo, le grand amour de Diana dans le passé, mais disputé par les deux rivaux dans le présent.

Bruno a utilisé le nom d'Alejandro pour épouser Maria Jose, peu après avoir envoyé tuer son frère dans l'espoir que Maria Jose hérite de la fortune d'Alejandro. Mais lorsque Maria Jose arrive au manoir, elle se rend compte que Bruno lui a menti et s'est servi d'elle.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate, triggering an ecological chain reaction. Apart from theological considerations, scholars all over the world have studied individual phenomena, trying to explain the causes of this Biblical disaster.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “… so there were lice upon man, and upon beast,” reports the Bible, “all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.” (Exodus 8:18, 17). Even today, two million people die every year from malaria transmitted by mosquitoes, mainly in Africa.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: The Gates of Hell 1941-1942
programme.desc: On June 22, 1941, Hitler invaded the Soviet Union. In the shadow of the war, Nazi regime gradually advances its "final solution to the Jewish problem".

programme.title: Genocide 1942-1944
programme.desc: Treblinka, Belzec Majdanek and Sobibor - the camps of "Operation Reinhardt," a Nazi murder campaign that took nearly two million lives within a few months in 1942/43.

programme.title: Armageddon 1943-1945
programme.desc: After the defeat of Stalingrad, the Nazis plan a kind of extended suicide on a global scale. Denunciations from the population ensure that the Gestapo can suppress almost any resistance.

programme.title: The Reckoning 1945-1948
programme.desc: After the war, winners and survivors want to hold the Germans responsible. The reckoning with National Socialism is ambivalent.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Warships secured the river borders formed by the Rhine and the Danube. The palisades, walls, trenches and forts of the Limes on land stretched across Germania, the wild "Barbaricum." The Limes was a bulwark that ran from northern Britain all the way to the Black Sea.

programme.title: The Limes, Season 1
programme.desc: Was the Limes Rome’s "iron curtain", its bulwark against the barbarians? Along the Limes military camps evolved into flourishing villages, protected by an impressive boundary and the Roman legions. But how endangered were these cities? How did the Limes hold against the attacks from tribes from the north?

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War
programme.desc: Pop culture is unthinkable without them, and so is the Cold War: UFO’s, those flying saucers allegedly bringing aliens to dominate the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough in the East
programme.desc: January 28, 1945. World War II comes to Germany. Total war, in all its drama, strikes back at the Germans and reaches its climax on German soil.

programme.title: Germany in Ruins
programme.desc: March 6, 1945. Cologne is the first major German city to fall to the Allies. Stalin plans to conquer Berlin before the other Allies arrive.

programme.title: Downfall and Liberation
programme.desc: April 16, 1945. The Red Army begins its offensive on Berlin. The first concentration camps have been liberated by British and US forces, who discovered emaciated prisoners and corpses.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

Des interviews d'experts retracent la vie de Hanssen, comment il est resté caché pendant plus de 20 ans, et les événements ayant mené à son arrestation.

programme.title: À Ceux qui Nous Ont Offensés
programme.desc: Vivants en parias à la périphérie du Gloucestershire, trois générations de Cutler, la célèbre famille de criminels professionnels, passent leur temps à planifier leur prochain casse et à se moquer de la police. Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l’aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu’il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d’art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s’effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s’affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n’en a qu’une.

programme.title: Le Contrat
programme.desc: Luc, un ancien assassin des opérations clandestines, est piégé et éliminé par un gouverneur ambitieux prêt à tout pour protéger sa carrière politique. Luc détenait des informations compromettantes qui menaçaient l’élection du politicien.Mais Luc n’était pas seul. Il avait élevé et formé la fille de son meilleur ami, devenue une tueuse redoutable et sa partenaire de mission.À son tour, elle devient la cible du gouvernement. Mais ils vont vite découvrir qu’elle est bien plus difficile à éliminer qu’ils ne l’avaient imaginé.Pour survivre et venger celui qui était comme un père pour elle, elle doit retrouver les assassins de Luc… avant qu’ils ne la retrouvent.

programme.sub-title: Journey Within S01 E01 - Costa Rica - JGO
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore Zunya, an eco-village, and its enchanting blue zone concept. We delve into communal living, uncovering its allure. Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Stuck on Christmas
programme.desc: Rival colleagues Synclaire and James, vying for a promotion, get stuck in an elevator. Their prank war turns into a desperate struggle for freedom, and to be free for Christmas.

programme.title: An Earl E. Christmas
programme.desc: Earl falls into deep debt after making some bad bets. He decides to fake a terminal illness to get the debt collectors off his tail, only to have his entire family show up at his home for one last special Christmas. But dysfunction and old grudges start to bubble over, making for a chaotic holiday weekend.

programme.title: Christmas Family Ties
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her mother, Amaya pleads to Santa to bring her family together for Christmas like they used to. Her father David, having fallen out with his siblings after his own mother's death, decides to bring her to their ancestral family home for the holiday. Will they survive the holiday with their own family dysfunction and financial ruin hanging over their heads?

programme.title: Ebony's Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Ebony Scrooge, a sharp-witted and stubborn winery owner, despises Christmas. Her holiday is abruptly interrupted by three spectral visitors who whisk her away on a transformative journey, forcing her to confront her buried pain and, perhaps, rediscover the true magic of the season.

programme.title: Festive Fling
programme.desc: After Shelly’s painful divorce, she was left feeling like the black sheep of the family. Desperate to move on from the pain of her past, she invites her co-worker Greg to visit her family to pretend to be her boyfriend to deflect her family’s unwanted comments. Little did she know, that her holiday fling, would become a holiday thing.

programme.title: Hard Holiday
programme.desc: LaDonne, a single mother of twins, is fighting to stay sober and hold her life together. But just weeks before Christmas, a job loss and mounting family pressures push her to the edge—and into trouble with the law. This heartfelt holiday drama is a powerful reminder that the greatest gifts come from within: healing, self-worth, and the strength to start over.

programme.title: Merry Little Baby

programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The wealthy, eccentric and obese Sir Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives to Haddington Hall to make an announcement. George Bullard tells Barnaby that the death was from natural causes. The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Worthy, council clerk Martin Barrett is shot to death through his kitchen window, while a mystery woman settles in, in the spare room upstairs. Barnaby and Jones discover Barrett was a skillful blackmailer, and believe his murderer to be one of his victims. The investigation takes Barnaby and Joyce to the seaside at Fennacombe Bay and Jones to question Sir John Waverley.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A 90-year-old feud between the male and female inhabitants of Broughton once again comes to a head with an event known as the Skimmington Ride. When elderly Ms Danvers is poisoned a short time before the event takes place. Barnaby and Jones have to investigate whether it was to do with the feud, a long held buried secret, or something else. This looks more likely when the Rev. Anthony Gant is shot and killed whilst taking part in the traditional ride. Before another villager ends up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Eleverton-cum-Latterly are divided over the building of a new supermarket development. Shortly after a heated meeting, Frank Hopkirk, an independent environmental supervisor is found stabbed at Jubb's timber yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate they find he came to the village for secret rendezvous with various female villagers in fantasy role-playing scenarios.
